sentences.text: Reanimation is the first remix album by American rock band Linkin Park as a follow-up to their first studio album , Hybrid Theory , and released on July 30 , 2002 .	Linkin Park	Linkin Park	Hybrid Theory	Hybrid Theory	remix album	remix album	rock	rock music	remix	remix
Recorded during the Hybrid Theory tour in 2001 , it features remixes of songs from Hybrid Theory , including the album 's bonus tracks .	Hybrid Theory	Hybrid Theory
The remix album was produced by Mike Shinoda and mixed by Mark `` Spike '' Stent .	Mike Shinoda	Mike Shinoda	remix album	remix album	remix	remix
